component.name: PDF Signer
component.summary: Fill in, sign, redact and watermark PDFs

description.p: PDF Signer fills in and signs PDF forms entirely on your computer. Nothing is uploaded.

ul.li: Type text, add dates and checkmarks anywhere on a page
Place your signature from an image; the paper background is removed automatically
Redact: black out content and remove it from the file for good
Stamp a watermark across every page

description.p: Long documents scroll and zoom smoothly: only the pages on screen are drawn.
Documents open in the background, and pages render and save faster.
Pasting works in form fields and the Recents search; form field borders keep their width.
Fill in a PDF's own form fields; the saved copy stays fillable.
Open password-protected PDFs, and save copies with a new password, the same one, or none.
Text in non-Latin scripts, written with fonts from your computer.
White redaction boxes, and a searchable Recents gallery.
Automatic updates: new versions are downloaded in the background, verified against the project's signing key, and installed on restart.
